summary: Retest of webm→mp4 transcode fix (iter 22 CRITICAL bug). Backend suite: all 7/7 tests in test_webm_transcode.py PASS — webm upload now returns .mp4 URL whose served bytes begin with ISO-BMFF ftyp and ffprobe reports h264. Original iOS Safari black-video bug is fixed at the transport layer. Frontend regression is BLOCKED: QA user fixture is missing the `age` field so App.js routeToNext() sends the session straight to Onboarding instead of Feed — feed-card-video never renders. This is a fixture-data issue, not a code regression.

integration_issues.issue: App.js routeToNext() (line 92) requires u.handle && u.first_name && u.city && u.age. QA user (id 2b0f5a67-…) returns from /api/auth/me with handle=qa.tester, first_name=QA, city='Marlton, NJ, USA' but NO `age` field. User is forced into Onboarding screen (screenshot: 'Create your profile', QA prefilled) and feed-card-video never mounts. Blocks all frontend feed regression testing.

action_items: Set `age` on the QA user fixture (id 2b0f5a67-2961-401f-889d-8672a49f7556) — e.g. age=30 — so routeToNext lands on 'feed'. Alternatively (weaker), add missing-age handling to the routing gate. After fix, retest the frontend regression items (single mp4 <source>, readyState≥2, like/pass/mute/city-pill).
Confirm QA user home_city stays 'Tokyo, Japan' after any fixture update (test_home_city.py depends on it).
critical_code_review_comments: FeedCard.js line 91 still emits type='video/webm' when URL ends in .webm — safe now that all stored intros are transcoded to mp4, but the branch is effectively dead code and could be removed to simplify.

routeToNext gate silently drops users to onboarding when ANY required field is missing (handle/first_name/city/age). Add a console.warn in dev mode listing which field failed — would have caught the missing-age fixture immediately.
